notes.title: Laser Heck Full Release Update
notes.notes:
Ready just in time for tomorrow's release (12:00 PM EDT), global leaderboards have been added to Laser Heck!  Choose a username and compete for the prestige of being the highest scoring individual (or team) in the world!

It's been a blast developing Laser Heck all of these months, but now it's time to launch.  I'll be paying close attention to balance over the coming days, and I'll be looking to tune the game to your feedback.
I hope that you all enjoy!

~Eric Krauss
